context: Saito tells Sho his teeth are doing well.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: しょうくん、歯、本当、立派、ね。
lines.en: Sho-kun, your teeth are truly wonderful.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. The composure of a doctor who has delivered countless check-ups, softened here by genuine affection. Slow pace, each word deliberate. Smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm trying really hard — every single day.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. Pride threaded through without boasting. Soft brightness on 「毎日」. The careful enunciation of a six-year-old doing something he believes in.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: What a kind child you are, truly.
lines.style: Quiet recognition in the voice. Not praising performance but seeing character. Slight pause after 「優しい」. The tenderness of someone who notices what others might miss.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: We'll keep trying together — I promise.
lines.style: Conviction underneath the softness. A small voice making a big commitment. Bright on the final words. The warmth of being held in an adult's promise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: You're going to stay healthy — truly.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Doctor's certainty meeting genuine care. Slow, reassuring finish. The word 「健康」 lands as a promise kept, not a prescription given.
